name: cascade_delete
description: In `delete_customer`, the code explicitly deletes child `orders` rows with `db.query(Order).filter(Order.o_custkey == c_custkey).delete(...)` before deleting the parent `customer`. This matches the unsafe delete cascade signal because the separate read endpoint `orders_history` depends on `orders` records, and after customer deletion those order-history rows are permanently removed, causing missing/incomplete history data.
